about_the_game:
They weighed your soul and found it wanting.

They cast you into the abyss to be forgotten.

Prove a legend's heart is heavy enough to shatter their world.

Soulsworn is a cooperative roguelite card game for 1-4 players. It's a mix of tactical gameplay with the chaotic fun of card games, where you and your friends will assume the roles of powerful souls unjustly condemned to Hell. To reclaim your freedom, you must work together, command the legions of the damned, and wage a war against the divine forces that cast you down.

FORGE YOUR REBELLION TOGETHER

Unite for couch co-op or online play (with Steam Remote Play Together) in a party of up to four. You are not just fighting side-by-side; you are a single entity, sharing one life pool and field. Protect each other, set up devastating combos, and function as a single, vengeful will.

FUSE FORBIDDEN POWERS

Your greatest weapon is the forbidden art of Fusion. Combine any two Soul cards to forge a new, more powerful being. A noble knight and a demonic beast? A mythical hydra and a clockwork golem? Discover hundreds of combinations, where knowledge and creativity can turn any board state into a winning one.

OUTWIT YOUR OPPRESSORS

Can you break their board?

Face powerful encounters who telegraph their deadliest moves before they happen. Each round is a high-stakes puzzle: can your team break their board and go for the win now? Or do you need to build a defense to survive the onslaught?

COMMAND THE LEGIONS OF HELL

Assemble an army from the most infamous and legendary souls ever condemned. Recruit mythological heroes, celestial outcasts, abyssal fiends, and primal beasts, each with unique Alignments and Origins that synergize with your strategy and unlock even more powerful fusions.

Features:

  • 1-4 Player Co-op: Battle for vengeance alone or with friends, both locally and online with Steam Remote Play Together.

  • Game-changing Fusions: Hundreds of potential combinations for you to discover.

  • Tactical Encounters: Fair but challenging AI that's learnable.

  • Vast Roster of Souls: A massive list of creatures to collect from across mythology and fantasy.

  • Endless Replayability: A roguelite structure with procedurally generated encounters ensures no two escape attempts are the same.

Your legend doesn't end in the abyss. It begins there.

Gather your allies, command the damned, and claim your vengeance.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.14 Mojave (or newer)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Newer
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable integrated or discrete GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey (or newer)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Newer
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated AMD GPU or Apple Silicon (M1/M2 and newer)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Fuse everything in this 1-4 player co-op roguelite, built for a chaotic game night. Combine the souls of heroes and monsters to discover hundreds of powerful creature combos. Team up to build off each other's creations and unleash attacks to shatter the heavens.
